stem: A payment API has a steady baseline relational load but periodic month-end spikes and wants better cost predictability with lower idle overprovisioning risk.

choices.text: Use Aurora Serverless v2 with a bounded ACU range for burst elasticity.
Use AWS Batch as the relational database hosting layer.
Use Amazon EMR as the primary OLTP engine for payment records.
Use AWS Transfer Family as the database compute autoscaler.

rationale: Aurora Serverless v2 scales compute ACUs within configured boundaries, reducing idle overprovisioning in variable workloads while keeping relational semantics. AWS Batch and EMR are compute and analytics platforms, not managed relational OLTP engines. Transfer Family handles file transfer endpoints, not database compute scaling.
